notes: 2026-09-13 FanGraphs refresh attempt: fangraphs.com was reachable on the first plain GET (200) but every subsequent request, including a bare GET to https://www.fangraphs.com/, returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' JS challenge (HTTP 403). This was verified via the agent egress-proxy status endpoint to be a real response from Cloudflare (no proxy/policy denial, no relay failures recorded), not something the environment's network policy was blocking. No workaround was attempted (no header spoofing beyond a standard browser UA/Accept set, no headless browser, no TLS fingerprint tricks) per policy against defeating anti-bot protections.

wrc_plus (mlb_team_offense.csv): FanGraphs wRC+ could not be fetched this run. Used the sanctioned fallback, Baseball-Reference Team Standard Batting OPS+ (https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2026.shtml, table id teams_standard_batting, column onbase_plus_slugging_plus), for all 30 teams. These are OPS+ values, NOT true wRC+ - do not treat this column as wRC+ until a future run successfully refreshes it from FanGraphs. Spot-checked 3+ teams (Arizona 96, Atlanta 97, Chicago Cubs 111, Colorado 92, Philadelphia 89, Washington 105) against the independently-scoped NL-only page (https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/NL/2026.shtml), which matched exactly.

xfip and siera (mlb_starters.csv): left completely unchanged this run. FanGraphs is the sole source for these two columns and has no sanctioned fallback, so per the cardinal rule (never write a number not read from a source) the existing previously-sourced values were left untouched rather than being blanked or guessed. mlb_starters.csv has zero diff vs the prior commit.
OPS+ fallback was used for wrc_plus this run; no fallback was available or used for xfip/siera.
